backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows for core baseline, plus production paper-sleeve replay over the same OHLCV snapshots. Core replay uses REPLAY_PARTIAL_REDUCES and REGIME_AWARE_EXIT.

gate.rule: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV improves in at least two windows with at most one EV-regression window, PnL improves in at least two windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points, and the sleeve keeps at least 40 closed trades.

hypothesis: Inside the accepted max-3 default-off SEC financial-report T+1 paper sleeve, requiring a larger ticker-vs-SPY T+1 excess reaction should improve event quality and replacement value without relying on LLM soft-ranking data.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Production-aligned LLM replay remains data-limited; this test uses deterministic PIT price-confirmation fields already present in the queue and paper ledger.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool/event quality: use T+1 ticker-vs-SPY excess reaction strength as a deterministic quality floor for the SEC financial-report paper sleeve.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: exp-20260511-112 tested capacity; exp-20260511-113 tested pending priority; exp-20260511-114 tested form_base exclusion. No logged experiment isolated the T+1 excess magnitude floor for this sleeve.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: Three fixed windows, aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, at least two EV-positive windows, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and at least 40 sleeve closed trades.
